name: SPEC-P-001 live census: every dispatch-requested consult on staging records a launch outcome
summary: consult:routing-health was run against the staging operator :3170 (/api/health sha 2998298920) for the request-time cohort 2026-10-12T00:00Z to 2026-10-13T00:49:00Z. It scanned 325 consults with truncatedByLimit false. 151 consults were requested: 31 dispatch-requested, 2 retrieval-only and 118 legacy rows with no delivery intent. All 31 dispatch-requested consults have a measured launch outcome (14 received, 15 unavailable, 2 failed, 0 pending, 0 unmeasured), which is the SPEC-P-001 property. The 2 retrieval-only consults never dispatch, by design. The 118 legacy rows carry no deliveryIntent stamp. The 00:34Z join in consult-backed-parking-p001-live-2026-10-13.md attributes every recent one to port-3070 at stale main d740fc3802, which predates the fix. This run covers staging and this workspace only. It does not establish production (:3070) coverage, which arrives only when main is promoted.

assertions.evidence: Per policy, dispatchRequested equals the outcome sum and unmeasured is 0: acceptance-bar-amendment-review 13 = 2 received + 9 unavailable + 2 failed; bar-critique 5 = 4 + 1; consult-default 9 = 5 + 4; rubric-vetting 4 = 3 + 1; acceptance-grading 0; grading-integrity-audit 0. Totals: 31 dispatch-requested = 14 received + 15 unavailable + 2 failed + 0 pending; unmeasured 0.
consult-default reports retrievalOnly=2, counted apart from dispatchRequested. Retrieval-only consults never dispatch, by design (get-feedback-core.ts retrievalOnly).

legacyIntentUnknown=118 (26 acceptance-bar-amendment-review, 72 consult-default, 20 rubric-vetting) is reported as its own column and not counted as dispatch-requested. The companion markdown join attributes these rows to the stale-main build on :3070, which stamps no deliveryIntent.
:3170 /api/health reported sha 2998298920 at 2026-10-13T00:49:01Z. :3070 reported d740fc3802 (stale main) at 00:47:41Z.

disclosures: Staging (:3170) only; production :3070 still serves stale main d740fc3802 and is not covered.
